single_nominal.description: Default race: 10 marbles, one tunnel, overtakes throughout.

multi_camera_failure.description: Two of the 14 cameras die mid-race for 3 s each; their sections become blind zones.

multi_worst_case.description: Everything at once: tight pack, three tunnels, 10% frame loss with 120 ms jitter, 20% lighting drop.

single_pack.description: Tight pack: near-identical speeds and wide lateral wander, so marbles constantly overlap and hide each other.
